first.rationale: Onboarding completion and activation are both declining, making a guarded onboarding simplification test the most directly aligned intervention. Verify the prior onboarding effect and the competing pricing evidence because both are consequential to qualified revenue, while avoiding an unverified broad pricing response that could acquire low-value accounts. Judge the test on downstream qualified revenue and retention, not completion alone.

final.rationale: Run a standard, guarded onboarding simplification experiment this week. The verified source shows completion increased 13%, time-to-value improved by 2.1 days, and 30-day retention increased 3%, directly addressing both current onboarding and activation declines while supporting sustainable revenue. Do not pursue promotional pricing: although it increased qualified revenue 18% short term, retention fell 12% and the cohort failed to survive renewal. Evaluate the onboarding test on qualified revenue, activation, and retention—not completion alone.
